data.narrative:
Unseenlabs is a Series C-stage Space & Aerospace company that has raised €112.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on two applicable methods triangulated against a comp universe of 6 private peers at the same or adjacent stage, alongside 5 public Space & Aerospace equities (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) held for reference.

The Stage-Progression method applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement to the €112.5M raised proxy, yielding €191M. The Peer-Median approach anchors on 6 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables—including Sierra Space (€8.0B, Series C), Apex Space (€2.3B, Series D), Cowboy Space Corporation (€2.0B, Series B), Varda Space Industries (€1.6B, Series D), and Aalyria (€1.3B, Series B)—producing a median valuation of €1.8B with a range of €1.15B to €8.0B. Public-comp anchoring via the sector P/S median of 27.4x is inapplicable due to absence of target revenue disclosure, typical of private companies.

Triangulation of the two applicable methods yields a valuation range of €163M (low) to €2.1B (high), with a median of €991M. The wide dispersion reflects meaningful variance in peer stage progression and capital intensity. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory, contract visibility, and the outsized impact of early-stage aerospace company volatility on peer multiples.
